polityNote: Togo from Loi 81-9 (1981-06-23): five regions, unchanged since (later prefectures were all cut inside one region: Noyoulewa; statoids). Atoms: the five regions of 2017 (OpenStreetMap via geoBoundaries TGO ADM1). Before 1981-06-23 see TGO-regions-1960.json. ① Areas (atom / Wikipedia 2015): Centrale 13289/13317 km² = 0.998; Kara 11544/11738 km² = 0.983; Maritime 6346/6100 km² = 1.040; Plateaux 17264/16975 km² = 1.017; Savanes 8695/8470 km² = 1.027.

sources.title: T. A. Noyoulewa (Université de Kara), « Le couple population / territoire dans les découpages administratifs au Togo », Revue CAMES
sources.says: Loi 60-4 (10 Feb 1960): four regions, 17 circonscriptions. Décret 65-148 (18 Sep 1965): five economic regions, Kara taken from three Centrale and one Savanes circonscription. Loi 81-9 (23 Jun 1981) moved Bassar and Bafilo to Kara.

sources.title: T. A. Noyoulewa, « Le couple population / territoire … au Togo », Revue CAMES — sub-prefectures and the 2009 law
sources.says: Loi 81-9 made 9 posts sub-prefectures inside their prefectures (raised to prefectures in 1992); Loi 2009-027 created Anié from five Ogou cantons and the Plaine du Mô from Sotouboua cantons.
